description: Generated deepcopy functions for Kubernetes policy API objects, including Eviction and PodDisruptionBudget types, used for deep copying Kubernetes API objects.

classes.name: Eviction
classes.description: Represents an eviction request for a Kubernetes pod, including metadata and delete options.

classes.name: PodDisruptionBudget
classes.description: Defines a policy to limit voluntary disruptions to pods.

classes.name: PodDisruptionBudgetSpec
classes.description: Specifies the desired state of a PodDisruptionBudget, including minAvailable, maxUnavailable, and selector.

classes.name: PodDisruptionBudgetStatus
classes.description: Current status of a PodDisruptionBudget, including disrupted pods and conditions.

methods.name: DeepCopyInto
methods.description: Copies receiver object into out, used for deep copying.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a new deep copy of the object.

methods.name: DeepCopyObject
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the object as runtime.Object.
